an1.316:1.1: ekapuggalo bhikkhave loke uppajjamāno uppajjati bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an1.316:1.4: so bahujanaṃ saddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā asaddhamme patiṭṭhāpeti.
an1.316:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave ekapuggalo loke uppajjamāno uppajjati bahujanāhitāya bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an1.317:1.1: ekapuggalo bhikkhave loke uppajjamāno uppajjati bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānaṃ.
an1.317:1.4: so bahujanaṃ asaddhammā vuṭṭhāpetvā saddhamme patiṭṭhāpeti.
an1.317:1.5: ayaṃ kho bhikkhave ekapuggalo loke upapajjamāno uppajjati bahujanahitāya bahujanasukhāya bahuno janassa atthāya hitāya sukhāya devamanussānanti.
an1.318:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammampi samanupassāmi, yaṃ evaṃ mahāsāvajjaṃ, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave micchādiṭṭhi.
an1.319:1.1: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekapuggalampi samanupassāmi, yo evaṃ bahujanāhitāya paṭipanno bahujanāsukhāya bahuno janassa anatthāya ahitāya dukkhāya devamanussānaṃ, yathayidaṃ bhikkhave makkhalī moghapuriso.
an1.319:1.2: seyyathāpi bhikkhave nadīmukhe khipaṃ oḍḍeyya bahunnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anatthāya vyasanāya.
an1.319:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave makkhalī moghapuriso manussakhipaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahunnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anatthāyāya vyasanāyāti.
an1.320:1.1: durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo ca samādapeti, yañca samādapeti, yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati, sabbe te bahuṃ apuññaṃ pasavanti.
an1.321:1.1: svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo ca samādapeti, yañca samādapeti, yo ca samādapito tathattāya paṭipajjati, sabbe te bahuṃ puññaṃ pasavanti.
an1.322:1.1: durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye dāyakena mattā jānitabbā, no paṭiggāhakena.
an1.323:1.1: svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye paṭiggāhakena mattā jānitabbā, no dāyakena.
an1.324:1.1: durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo āraddhaviriyo, so dukkhaṃ viharati.
an1.325:1.1: svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo kusīto, so dukkhaṃ viharati.
an1.326:1.1: durakkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo kusīto, so sukhaṃ viharati.
an1.327:1.1: svākkhāte bhikkhave dhammavinaye yo āraddhaviriyo, so sukhaṃ viharati.
an1.328:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakopi gūtho duggandho hoti,
an1.328:1.2: evamevaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave appamattakampi bhavaṃ na vaṇṇemi, antamaso accharāsaṅghātamattampīti.
an1.329:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakampi muttaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti …pe… appamattakopi kheḷo duggandho hoti …pe… appamattakopi pubbo duggandho hoti …pe… appamattakampi lohitaṃ duggandhaṃ hoti,
an1.329:1.2: evamevaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave appamattakampi bhavaṃ na vaṇṇemi, antamaso accharāsaṅghātamattampīti.
